name: @movie-platform/audit-account
description: Dedicated audit-account CDK application and operator boundary

scripts.synth: npm run synth:foundation && npm run synth:ingestion
scripts.synth:foundation: MOVIE_PLATFORM_AUDIT_ACCOUNT_CONFIG_FILE=$PWD/test/fixtures/audit-account-config.json AWS_REGION=eu-central-1 npm run cdk -- synth AuditAccountStack --no-lookups --output ../../cdk.out/audit-account-foundation
scripts.synth:ingestion: MOVIE_PLATFORM_AUDIT_ACCOUNT_CONFIG_FILE=$PWD/test/fixtures/audit-account-config.json MOVIE_PLATFORM_SECURITY_LAKE_CUSTOM_SOURCE_RESPONSE_FILE=$PWD/test/fixtures/security-lake-custom-source-response.json AWS_REGION=eu-central-1 npm run cdk -- --app "npx ts-node --project tsconfig.json --prefer-ts-exts bin/audit-account-ingestion.ts" synth AuditAccountIngestionStack --no-lookups --output ../../cdk.out/audit-account-ingestion
